Finish P1 workspace/project/source-control and complete Public UI/API authoring journeys; verify exact-project authorization, persistence and restart behavior.
Complete P2 provider/format/failure-recovery coverage for HTTP/REST, generic JDBC, PostgreSQL, S3/Azure/Ozone profiles; distinguish local emulators from production provider certification.
Close P3/P4 execution paths: cancellation, asset registration/source revision, CPU bounds, full notebook/SQL/pipeline CRUD, worker/evidence lineage and PostgreSQL runtime qualification.
Close P5 scheduler gaps with full controller/daemon recovery, supported Compose restart behavior, PostgreSQL task evidence, and notification-provider/operator conformance.
Complete P6 catalog/ontology asset-family integration and provider/consumer certification; complete P7 provider qualification for quality contracts and release decisions.
Complete remaining P8 classical-ML capabilities only where required by the public scope; qualify durable artifacts/providers and end-to-end Studio journeys. No GenAI runtime.

Complete P10 semantic export/import qualification; for P11 add broader operational evidence and qualify the complete family on a clean candidate; complete P12 SDK parity, service adoption and alert/FinOps operational journeys.
Complete P13 external-provider qualification and P14 backup/restore, migration and single-node Helm qualification; keep Ronin Pro multi-user/HA outside Public v1.
Finish native Bundle PostgreSQL adapters, cross-domain rollback/recovery and API/CLI/Studio round trips; verify exact replay and remapping for every supported domain.
Resolve human release decisions: package versions, public claims, license/NOTICE/attribution reviews and release approval. Do not infer or fabricate legal approval.

Run full local/manual qualification on one clean candidate SHA: Python/PostgreSQL, live API/browser, Docker/strict acceptance, security/secrets, container inventory, artifact/SBOM/provenance and supported OS/Python matrix; review visual UI manually.
Issue GO only if every mandatory family and human-owned gate passes for that exact candidate; otherwise keep NO-GO and delay publication.
